captured_by: Arena platform-side page fetch of the official pages (markdown extraction). Raw HTML is not stored in-repo; every URL below is exact so a human can re-open the same page and re-check each field.
why_not_the_runner: GitHub runners recorded HTTP 403 (Cloudflare challenge) on hltv.org in sessions 3016b0c6, 3a5448de, ca4d2a02 and others. This session's egress reads HLTV successfully, so the claims 'HLTV publishes no two-sided prematch price' and 'the current weekly ranking publication is X' are verified here from a working read instead of from a blocked request.
policy: No probability, pick or alias is derived from anything in this file. HLTV fan votes are community participation and are excluded by the project's source rules. Rank positions are identity/strength context only; the project's HLTV rung reads the official ranking pages itself on the runner.

betting_block.contents: bookmaker affiliate promos (Stake) and a link to HLTV's analytics centre; no decimal odds or two-sided price are published in the page
betting_block.conclusion: HLTV publishes no two-sided prematch price for this fixture; the project's 'HLTV first, then books' order therefore means HLTV contributes identity, format, lineup and ranking context, and the price must come from a market or esportsbook

findings.fixture: HLTV weekly world ranking publication date
findings.evidence: the official rank links on the live match page point at /ranking/teams/2026/october/19/<teamId>; the project's HLTV rung accepts publications up to 14 days old and reads the canonical /ranking/teams redirect, so a runner fetch on or after 2026-10-19 uses this publication
findings.note: An older rendered page in the repository (docs build of 12 October) predates this publication; any row still citing 2026-10-12 was priced from the publication that was current when its evidence was saved, and the four-hour ladder re-reads the ranking on every successful run
